title: Products and Sectors
intro: Discover the essence of premium packaging solutions with our curated collection, designed to cater to a spectrum of needs. From safeguarding delicate items with our robust ziplocks to presenting your products in style with our custom textiles, each offering is a testament to our commitment to quality and functionality. Embrace the confidence that comes with choosing packaging that stands the test of time and elevates the user experience, no matter the industry or occasion.

categories.title: Resealable Ziplock Bags
categories.description:
Discover versatile storage solutions with our unique Resealable Ziplock Bags, tailored to your needs. These Ziplocks are ideal for robust needs in jewelry, spare-parts, manufacturing, office organization, medical storage, and home use.

  • Plain Ziplock Bags
  • Ziplock Bags with Customized Print
  • Ziplock Bags with Patch Handles

Personalize your Ziplocks with our customizable features like patch handles and printed artwork to create a perfect fit for your requirements.

categories.title: Food Grade Packaging
categories.description: Explore our government certified top-tier selection of food-grade packaging, designed with the integrity of your food products in mind. Our packaging materials range from LDPE to HDPE and PP, ensuring versatility and strength for a multitude of applications. Whether you need packaging for tea, sugar, flour, or bakery goods, our products offer features like high sealability, customized color options, and a choice between printed or unprinted designs.

categories.title: Retail & Wholesale Bags
categories.description: Discover the ultimate blend of elegance and durability with our Retail Textile Bags, crafted for businesses seeking a premium customer experience. Our bags come in a variety of forms, including bottom and side seals with optional gussets to accommodate any retail necessity. Choose from an array of handles such as reinforced, patch, carrier, or kidney cut to add convenience and strength. With the possibility to select between vibrant printed designs or a classic unprinted look, our bags not only carry your goods but also convey the quality of your brand.

categories.title: Agriculture
categories.description:
Enhance your agricultural operations with our specialized packaging solutions, tailored for the rigors of the farming industry. Our range includes Nursery Bags with customizable widths and lengths, with options for perforation to suit the unique needs of your crops. For the utmost protection against the elements, consider our 3-Layer Films, ideal for plantation rain guards, offering exceptional durability, strength, and elongation. 

Our 2 Layer Co-Extrusion options combine HDPE and LDPE for reinforced packaging strength, available in various sizes to match your specifications. Whether printed or unprinted, our products ensure your goods are shielded during transport and storage, maintaining their quality from field to market.

categories.title: Garment
categories.description: Unveil the beauty of your fashion pieces with our premium garment packaging solutions. Our hanger bags, crafted from virgin LDPE, are customizable to the dimensions of your choice, ensuring a perfect fit for any clothing item. Embrace the flexibility of our shirt packaging and envelope bags, which are available with personalized printing options to showcase your brand’s aesthetic. Additional features like adhesive tape and gusset bottom folds provide ease of use while enhancing the product’s presentation. Opt for our garment packaging to deliver an impeccable first impression, whether on the retail floor or during customer delivery, safeguarding the quality and allure of your apparel.

categories.title: Household Items
categories.description: Dive into our household collection where functionality meets aesthetic appeal. Our HDPE Garbage Bags are engineered for strength, capable of handling industrial waste without succumbing to leaks or tears, available in dimensions ranging from 24-30 inches in width and up to 100 in gauge. Complementing our tough bags are our stylishly designed Table Cloths made from LLDPE/LDPE, customizable in width starting at 24 inches and gauge up to 200, with higher gauges available on request. These table cloths are not just protective covers but also bring a splash of elegance to your dining area, with options for double-sided printing in up to 2-6 colors. Upgrade your home essentials with our range that doesn’t compromise on durability or design

categories.title: Multi-Color Polythene Reels
categories.description: Elevate the presentation and protection of your products and services with our vibrant Multi-Color Polythene Reels. These reels are perfect for a variety of applications, from construction sites to plantation fields, offering not just durability but also a splash of color to your packaging needs. Opt for our custom-sized reels for your specific requirements, whether for protective sheeting, vapour barriers, weatherproofing, or pipe insulation. Our reels provide a practical yet aesthetically pleasing solution to meet the dynamic demands of your industry.

categories.title: Gusset Bags
categories.description: Adapt to any packaging challenge with our custom-designed Gusset Bags, ideal for a variety of sectors including textile, retail, and supermarkets. These bags offer flexibility with their expandable design, ensuring even the most uniquely shaped items fit with ease. Tailored to your dimensional needs, our bags feature both bottom and side folds, providing a robust and practical solution for your storage and transportation demands. Choose our Gusset Bags for a seamless blend of functionality and adaptability.
